name: Grunt
description: The bayou's walking dead. Slow, stupid, and never alone.

abilities.name: Horde
abilities.text: Grunts come in groups: each extra Grunt in the zone gives the others +1 to attack (max +2).

name: Hive
description: A shambling host for a cloud of stinging insects.

abilities.name: Headshot
abilities.text: A Vital hit kills the Hive outright.

name: Armored
description: A brute wrapped in a shell of hardened filth and scrap. Bullets flatten on it; only the head is soft.

abilities.name: Shell
abilities.text: Armour 4 against every hit that isn't Vital: pistol rounds barely scratch it. A Vital hit (the head) ignores the armour.

name: Meathead
description: Huge, blind, and hunting by sound. Leeches crawl off it to find you. It takes a lot of lead.

abilities.name: Blind
abilities.text: It only notices what it hears: Stealth against it gets +2.

abilities.name: Leeches
abilities.text: Each exchange a hunter spends in its zone, roll 1dF: on a −, a leech bites (1 damage).

abilities.name: Mass
abilities.text: 18 Health and armour 1: plan on several hits, or on getting out of its way.

name: Immolator
description: A burning husk. Shoot it wrong and it bursts into flame.

abilities.name: Volatile
abilities.text: A bullet, blade, arrow or blast that doesn't kill it sets it ablaze: a fire burst (power 2, radius 4 m) catches everyone around it, its zone gains Burning Ground, and it burns until it dies. Blunt weapons and choke smoke don't set it off. A Vital hit kills it cleanly.

name: Hellhound
description: Fast, quiet until the howl, and never far from its pack.

abilities.name: Pack Hunter
abilities.text: Moves two zones per exchange. Each other Hellhound in the zone gives +1 to attack.

name: Water Devil
description: It waits in deep water and drags the unwary under.

abilities.name: Submerged
abilities.text: Only found in Deep Water zones. While submerged it can't be targeted; it surfaces to attack.

name: Flayed
description: A man with no skin left, his forearms hacked off and the bones whittled to points. It shuffles and moans, blind, listening. When it hears you, it screams and comes.

abilities.name: Blind
abilities.text: Immune to Blinded: smoke, flash bombs and darkness don't hinder it. It only notices what it hears: a hunter who stays still or moves crouched is not noticed.

abilities.name: Fine Hearing
abilities.text: Notice +4 against noise. A gunshot, a sprint, an explosion or a fight within two zones triggers it (Phase: Triggered).

abilities.name: Charge
abilities.text: Triggered: it screams and moves two zones, then attacks in the same exchange. Every hunter in the zone it reaches rolls Will against its dread.

abilities.name: Bone Spikes
abilities.text: Every hit makes the target bleed; a second hit turns it into Heavy Bleeding.

phases.name: Wandering
phases.note: Shuffles and moans, one zone every other exchange. A hunter can slip past or ambush it.

phases.name: Triggered
phases.note: Screaming charge: two zones and an attack in the same exchange. It stays triggered until it loses its prey for a whole exchange.

name: Myconid
description: What is left of a man under a heap of fungus, shelf caps and grey mould. It moves slowly and breathes out spores. Kill it and it bursts — unless it burns.

abilities.name: Slow
abilities.text: Moves one zone every other exchange and never runs. Athletics −1: easy to hit.

abilities.name: Spongy
abilities.text: Armour 2: bullets go through the mould. A Vital hit reaches the core and ignores the armour.

abilities.name: Spore Breath
abilities.text: Cone, Close and Medium: no damage, everyone caught is Poisoned (1 damage each exchange, no healing until an antidote).

abilities.name: Spore Cloud
abilities.text: When it dies, a spore cloud bursts 4 m around it: Athletics vs Good (+3) or Poisoned, and the zone becomes a Spore Cloud.

abilities.name: Burn It
abilities.text: Fire kills it outright, and a Myconid that burns releases no cloud.

deathBurst.label: Spore Cloud
deathBurst.zoneAspect: Spore Cloud (Poisoned each exchange you stay)

name: Drowned
description: Swollen corpses that wait under the black water and rise together when something wades in. Slow and clumsy on land.

abilities.name: Submerged
abilities.text: Only in Deep Water zones. Hidden under the surface until it attacks: Notice vs its Stealth to spot the ripples. Submerged, it defends at +2.

abilities.name: Drag Under
abilities.text: A hit leaves the hunter Pinned. A Pinned hunter in deep water takes 1 damage at the end of each exchange (drowning) until an Athletics overcome vs Fair (+2) frees them.

abilities.name: Pack
abilities.text: They come in groups: each other Drowned in the zone gives +1 to attack (max +2).

abilities.name: Waterlogged
abilities.text: Soaked through: fire doesn't kill it outright. On land it moves one zone every other exchange.

phases.name: Submerged
phases.note: Under the surface: hidden, hard to hit.

name: The Hanged
description: A long, thin shape folded in the rafters of barns and the branches over the road, a noose still around its neck. It drops on whoever walks alone and hauls them up into the dark.

abilities.name: Lurker
abilities.text: Waits above (rafters, trees, lofts) at Stealth 4. Spotting it is Notice vs its Stealth. Its first attack from hiding is against an unaware target (untick Target aware: Mediocre defence).

abilities.name: Hoist
abilities.text: A hunter hit by Drop and Hoist is lifted off the ground: Pinned, Fight only at −2, no Shoot. Teammates free them by hitting the Hanged or with an Athletics overcome vs Fair (+2).

abilities.name: Rope-Necked
abilities.text: A Vital hit (the neck) kills it outright.

abilities.name: Back Into the Dark
abilities.text: When hurt, it climbs back up: next exchange it is hidden again unless someone keeps it in sight.

phases.name: Lurking
phases.note: Hidden above, waiting for someone alone.

phases.name: Hoisting
phases.note: Holding a hunter aloft: exposed, easy to hit.

name: The Chanter
aspect: Leads the Hymn That Calls You In
description: A gaunt preacher at the head of a choir of the dead. Its hymn pulls the living toward the pews. Silence it and the choir falls apart.

abilities.name: The Hymn
abilities.text: At the end of each exchange, every hunter within 15 m rolls Will vs Good (+3): on a failure they are Shaken and drawn one zone toward the Chanter (they must spend their next move on it).

abilities.name: The Choir
abilities.text: Comes with 4–8 Grunts singing in the pews. While the Chanter lives they stand and sing; they attack whoever reaches the altar.

abilities.name: Silence
abilities.text: When the Chanter dies, the hymn stops at once and the choir breaks: the Grunts scatter and fight as ordinary Grunts.

abilities.name: Rope-Thin
abilities.text: A Vital hit kills it outright.

aura.label: The Hymn
aura.text: Those who fail are drawn one zone toward it.

name: The Butcher
description: A pig-faced giant with a burning hammer and a meat hook.

attacks.name: Fire Breath
attacks.text: Everyone in front of it in its zone defends with Athletics.

abilities.name: Fireproof Hide
abilities.text: Fire never kills it outright.

name: The Spider
description: It moves on walls and ceilings and spits poison from the dark.

abilities.name: Wall Crawler
abilities.text: Ignores terrain aspects and moves two zones per exchange, including over walls and roofs.

name: The Assassin
description: A shape of swarming insects that splits into copies of itself.

abilities.name: Clones
abilities.text: Once per scene, splits into three: two decoys (Grunt toughness, no attack) and the real one. Only Notice vs its Stealth tells them apart.

name: Scrapbeak
description: A plated hoarder with an anchor for a weapon. It wants your loot.

abilities.name: Hoarder
abilities.text: Drawn to items: when it hits, it can take one tool or consumable from the target instead of dealing Health damage.

name: Rotjaw
description: A giant swamp beast that hunts from the water.

abilities.name: Breach
abilities.text: Lives in Deep Water. Submerged, it can't be targeted; when it breaches to attack, it can be shot until its next action.
